persons.name: ulkser
persons.digest:
He is skeptical about the **US-Iran** deal story: on the "breakthrough expected this week" headline shared by Walter Bloomberg, he says it is the 4502nd such headline, that the market budged a little only because it had been beaten up so much, and that everyone is fed up with this kind of news by now.

persons.digest: He says the Black Monday did not happen, which is what he expected, but stresses it does not mean the decline is over: volatility is possible today and tomorrow, big selling could come Thursday; still, he expects a recovery within a week and a strong rally before election uncertainty ends.
